versions.changelog:
Anime character sheet skill initial version.

- Generates detailed anime character profiles including persona, catchphrases, clothing, and relationship network.
- Ensures every character sheet includes three key elements: contradictory traits, ability costs, and tension-based relationships.
- Performs a comprehensive consistency self-check, following a 10-item checklist, with results appended to the profile.
- Accepts partial or minimal user input, filling in defaults as needed and clearly noting all assumptions for transparency.
- Produces text-only content in structured markdown; no images or drawing prompts are generated.
- Designed for seamless use in writing, tabletop roleplaying, or as briefs for artists.
